definition.description: Sit tall on a clean stable mat or floor with both legs extended together. Fold forward from the hips toward the shins through a comfortable controllable range, then return to a tall stacked seated position before the next repetition. One complete fold-and-tall-return is one repetition. Pause and reset between repetitions. Range, reach target, breath, tempo, repetitions, rest, surface, and cueing are delivery annotations. Static pike stretches, bent-knee folds, straddle folds, sit-ups, V-ups, loaded work, assessments, and clinical interventions are different tasks requiring their own reviewed variant or definition.

breathe instead of forcing the reach
